svg.title: Figure 3-SG-04-1. SG-04: from the fault tree to the FMEA
svg.desc: Figure 3-SG-04-1. SG-04: 35 events (backed 28, by design 2, external 5, unbacked 0); 39 FMEA modes reach SG-04 (in the tree 33, justified 5, tree gaps 1). Single points: BE-4.01: SWF-003, 3 causes, D 3–9, partly detected; BE-4.03: DFM-019, 2 causes, D 10, not detected; BE-4.11: SFM-009, SWF-051, 5 causes, D 8–10, not detected; BE-4.14: SWF-053, 1 causes, D 9, not detected; BE-4.24: SWF-017, SFM-020, SWF-057, 4 causes, D 3–10, partly detected. BE-4.01 (Envelope bound −3.5 m/s² (toyota.h:209) not derived (GAP-04; CCF → DFI-08)) → SWF-003: Acceleration request outside the intended envelope is passed; worst cause SWF-003.C1 (Panda upper bound +2.0 m/s² equals the SoC limit (RAISED_ACCEL_LIMIT is set for every TSS2 car, values.py:39-43) and is not derived from a validated Corolla envelope; no margin between controller and envelope; O 6, D 9, AP H); detection: No test targets this cause BE-4.03 (Frame corrupted after the TX hook (as BE-1.10; TSR-517)) → DFM-019: Approved CAN frame altered between the TX check and the bus; worst cause DFM-019.C1 (Soft error or permanent fault in the copy into FDCAN message RAM, the message RAM or the FDCAN core. The packet XOR is checked at the FDCAN load (fdcan.h:100) and covers only the software queue; the CAN CRC is computed after the fault; O 3, D 10, AP H); detection: No LionDriver hardware verification or qualification test exists for this cause (WP-H-06/WP-H-07 not started; no HIL bench, D-04) BE-4.02 (Planner or controller fault (QM), false lead) → SFM-009: Unintended or excessive deceleration (phantom braking); worst cause SFM-009.C2 (Longitudinal controller overshoot; O 7, D 10, AP H); detection: test_longcontrol.py covers state transitions, not limits BE-4.16 (Envelope software defect in the longitudinal checks (longitudinal_accel_checks, longitudinal.h:8-12)) → SWF-003, SWF-016: Acceleration request outside the intended envelope is passed; worst cause SWF-003.C1 (Panda upper bound +2.0 m/s² equals the SoC limit (RAISED_ACCEL_LIMIT is set for every TSS2 car, values.py:39-43) and is not derived from a validated Corolla envelope; no margin between controller and envelope; O 6, D 9, AP H); detection: No test targets this cause BE-1.07 (MCU execution fault (RAM/register/CPU) corrupts limit or check, not detected (no MPU, no ECC handling, faults report-only; GAP-08)) → DFM-001, DFM-002, DFM-003, DFM-005, DFM-007, DFM-018: Safety check computes a wrong result (permanent CPU or data-path fault); worst cause DFM-007.C1 (Vehicle supply dip (cranking, alternator fault) with BOR level not set and PVD not enabled; O 5, D 10, AP H); detection: No LionDriver hardware verification or qualification test exists for this cause (WP-H-06/WP-H-07 not started; no HIL bench, D-04) BE-1.08 (Safety mode/param changed by SoC (0xdc, GAP-09) [FFI → FFI-CM-06; CCF → DFI-13: same SoC fault can cause G-SoC and BE-1.08]) → SWF-013, SWF-022: Wrong or permissive safety mode accepted from the host; worst cause SWF-022.C1 (setSafetyMode writes safety_configs[0] model and param and alternative_experience exactly as found in CarParams (panda_safety.cc:56-70). There is no allow-list for the reference configuration. A fingerprinting or CarParams error, such as a wrong EPS factor or flags, reaches the panda. At BL-004 the panda accepted any mode; at BL-005 the reference lock refuses anything but TOYOTA/73 (SWF-013), so the remaining effect is the safe direction (no engagement); O 7, D 10, AP H); detection: No test targets this cause; test_pandad.py (hardware) checks only that pandad starts BE-1.09 (Envelope firmware replaced via boot pins / softloader (GAP-38, GAP-24) [FFI → FFI-CM-12; CCF → DFI-13]) → SWF-028, PFM-001, DFM-016, PFM-002, SWF-084: pandad runs against panda firmware that is not the assured reference build; worst cause SWF-028.C1 (pandad.py and up_to_date() compare the panda signature with the panda_h7.bin.signed built from the checkout (pandad.py:16-18, 29-49; panda.cc:116-127). At BL-004 that build was not LIONDRIVER_REFERENCE. At BL-005 it is by default, and pandad checks the reference-build flag (TSR-619). Remaining: the flag says "a reference build", not "the assured release image" (any LIONDRIVER_REFERENCE build of any commit sets it), and a build opted out on both sides passes; O 5, D 10, AP H); detection: No host test of the pandad check. The panda side (flag set only in the reference build) is unit-tested in panda CI; the release build check is in CI (SWF-013.C2). Neither is designed to detect a non-assured reference image UE-4.04 (PCM executes the request without its own bound (AOU-05R fails)): No FMEA row needed: external; AOU-05R BE-4.17 (Host sends a step: the CarController jerk limit is applied before pitch compensation and the PID (carcontroller.py:197-238)) → SWF-046, SWF-066: ACC acceleration command differs from controlsd's request (higher, lower or faster changing) within the panda range; worst cause SWF-046.C2 (controlsd passes aTarget through unchanged up to the panda limits (LongControl is feed-forward for Toyota, ki=kp=0, interfaces.py:212-214; limits = ACCEL_MIN/MAX, toyota/interface.py:21-22), so the host adds no margin or jerk bound of its own; O 7, D 10, AP H); detection: test_longcontrol.py covers state transitions, not limits BE-4.05 (No negative-jerk limit in the envelope: step to −3.5 m/s² allowed (GAP-04; FSR-04.02 not implemented)) → SWF-004: Step change of deceleration request to the minimum is passed; worst cause SWF-004.C1 (longitudinal_accel_checks checks the range only; no rate or jerk limit on acceleration requests; O 8, D 9, AP H); detection: No test targets this cause BE-4.06 (Phantom braking or false lead) → SFM-009, PFM-011: Unintended or excessive deceleration (phantom braking); worst cause SFM-009.C2 (Longitudinal controller overshoot; O 7, D 10, AP H); detection: test_longcontrol.py covers state transitions, not limits BE-4.18 (Stale or replayed command, or a frozen planner output, held as braking (sendcan age gate 1 s, no freshness check in controlsd; GAP-10, GAP-16)) → SWF-023, SWF-043: Stale or burst-replayed sendcan frames forwarded to the panda; worst cause SWF-023.C1 (The age gate is 1 s (pandad.cc:78-79). That exceeds the 0.9 s preliminary SG-001 FTTI and is 100 control periods long. The sendcan subscriber is a non-conflated FIFO (pandad.cc:64; services.py sendcan MEDIUM queue), so a backlog of up to 1 s is forwarded in order but back-to-back. No newest-only policy applies per address (WP-W-04 SWF-47, SWSR-411); O 8, D 10, AP H); detection: No test targets this cause BE-4.07 (Envelope passes any in-bound value while authority is granted (by design)): No FMEA row needed: by design; The envelope passes any in-bound request while authority is granted; the hazard is the request (G4.3.1). UE-4.08 (Following traffic closer than the controllability assumption): No FMEA row needed: external; WP-C-03 HE-04.1 exposure (following traffic) BE-4.09 (DM no-response or fault soft-disable deceleration (HE-04.3; intended)): No FMEA row needed: by design; Intended driver-monitoring or fault soft-disable deceleration (HE-04.3); hazardous only unannounced (G4.4.1). BE-4.10 (Soft-disable deceleration announced only at its start (longitudinal_planner.py:84-85; TSR-624)) → SWF-050, SFM-026: Item-initiated deceleration starts without a prior announcement; worst cause SFM-026.C1 (UI process hung or display off; O 6, D 10, AP H); detection: No pre-release test targets this cause
